_doc: Creative editor and terrain tuning (SPEC 9.1-9.3). Read once at start-up by terrain_chunks.cpp and editor_nav.cpp.

mapSize._doc: Buildable area per side in metres; the terrain extends `margin` beyond it. Above comfortableKm2 the New Map dialog warns ([DECISION] 3.0 km2: the 1200 x 2400 default maps are the largest comfortable size on min spec).

terrainStream._doc: Chunk LOD distances (m, 3D distance to the chunk box) for vertex steps 1/2/4/10 cells; beyond the last, 20. Meshes farther than maxDist are evicted.

camera._doc: Editor camera. Fly speed = clamp(heightAboveGround * speedPerMetre + speedBase, speedMin, speedMax) x the Alt+wheel multiplier (x shiftMult with Shift).

overview._doc: Top-down overview map (M): heightmap texture resolution on the long side and default window fraction.

dropIn._doc: Drop-in explorer: the drag must move this far over the ground before it sets the facing; markers.
